For this purpose, the Commission issued a Public Notice on 03.07.2026 along with a proposal for “Determination of the levellised generic tariff for the third year of the control period under Regulation 8 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions for Tariff determination from Renewable Energy Sources) Regulations, 2024” and invited comments/suggestions/objections from the stakeholders. The last date for submission of comments/suggestions/objections was 21.07.2026.

6. In response to this public notice, written comments/ suggestions/ objections were received from the following Stakeholders:

7. The Commission has considered the comments/ suggestions/ objections of the stakeholders, and the analysis/decision of the Commission thereon is dealt with in relevant paragraphs of this order.

- 8.7 The Commission has noted the submissions of the stakeholders. As discussed in paragraph 13 of the proposal, the Commission has reviewed the normative capital cost specified under the RE Tariff Regulations, 2024 with reference to the capital cost norms specified by various State Commissions and project-specific tariff orders issued by various State Commissions based on prevailing market conditions. The review indicates that the capital cost specified under the RE Tariff Regulations, 2024 is broadly aligned with the prevailing market conditions. Accordingly, the Commission has decided to retain the normative capital cost specified under the RE Tariff Regulations, 2024 for the third year (FY 2026-27) of the Control Period. However, the capital cost of various technologies will be reviewed as part of the exercise of finalisation of RE Tariff Regulations for the next control period.

- 9.3 The ROE for determining the generic tariff is as per the RE Tariff Regulations, 2024. These suggestions tantamount to amendments in the RE Tariff Regulations, 2024, and therefore any change in the ROE is outside the scope of the present exercise of determining the levellised generic tariff.
